# predecessor organization

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:predecessorOrganization`](gmeow-predecessorOrganization.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/predecessorOrganization>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/organization`](../../slices/organization.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

An organization that ceases or transforms in a multi-organization change event — a merger, split, spin-off, acquisition, or rename. Non-functional: a merger has several predecessors, and competing standpoint-indexed predecessor claims coexist.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) -> [`gmeow:Organization`](../classes/gmeow-Organization.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:predecessorOrganization`](gmeow-predecessorOrganization.md) from [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) to [`gmeow:Organization`](../classes/gmeow-Organization.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use on a multi-organization change [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) (merger, split, acquisition, rename) to name an organization that ceased or transformed in it.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting a direct organization-to-organization succession edge (the change is mediated by an [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md)) and avoid forcing one predecessor — a merger has several, and contested succession claims coexist via [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### How to use

- Reify the change as a [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md), attach each prior organization with [`gmeow:predecessorOrganization`](gmeow-predecessorOrganization.md) and each resulting one with [`gmeow:successorOrganization`](gmeow-successorOrganization.md); carry contested succession with [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md) on the statements.

### Examples

- ex:merger [`gmeow:predecessorOrganization`](gmeow-predecessorOrganization.md) ex:oldcoA, ex:oldcoB.
